metadata.title: Obadiah
metadata.subtitle: Obadiah 1:1–21 (10 questions)
metadata.description: Questions on the Book of Obadiah according to the King James Version (1769).
metadata.author: King James Version (1769)

questions.text: Concerning which people is the vision of Obadiah in Obadiah 1:1?

options.text: Concerning Moab
Concerning Edom
Concerning Ammon
Concerning Syria

questions.text: How does Obadiah 1:4 describe the pride of Edom?

options.text: Though thou be mightier than all nations, yet will I bring thee down
Though thou dwell securely upon high rocks, yet will I bring thee down
Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, thence will I bring thee down
Though thou be richer than all earthly kings, yet will I bring thee down

questions.text: What promise is given in Obadiah 1:17, 21 concerning mount Zion?

options.text: Upon mount Moriah shall be lasting peace, and the kingdom shall be the LORD's
In all the land of Canaan shall be safety, and the kingdom shall be the LORD's
Among all heathen nations shall be repentance, and the kingdom be the LORD's
Upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s

questions.text: Where did Edom dwell in pride according to Obadiah 1:3?

options.text: In the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high
In tents of the wilderness, by springs of water
In the isles of the sea, in stately cedar houses
In the plains of Jordan, within fenced strong cities

questions.text: What does Obadiah 1:7 declare concerning Edom's confederates?

options.text: They have brought thee to the border and deceived thee before thou knowest
They send thee rich succour and defend all thy high mountain fortresses
They depart peacefully away and confirm an everlasting solemn covenant
They remain faithful unto thee and fight valiantly at thy right hand

questions.text: What does Obadiah 1:11-12 charge against Edom in the day of his brother's calamity?

options.text: He sent ambassadors to Jerusalem, yet they tarried and gave no assistance
He stood on the other side as strangers and rejoiced over the children of Judah
He took captive the refugees of Judah and delivered them up to foreign kings
He hid himself in secret places and mourned with the afflicted people of God

questions.text: What is near upon all the heathen according to Obadiah 1:15?

options.text: The judgment of the king
The salvation of all people
The day of the LORD
The covenant of peace

questions.text: What principle of judgment is pronounced in Obadiah 1:15?

options.text: Whosoever judgeth himself shall never be condemned by any other judge
As the fathers have transgressed, so shall the children bear punishment
Whatsoever a man soweth in this world, that shall he reap sevenfold
As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward upon thine head

questions.text: To what are the house of Jacob, Joseph, and Esau compared in Obadiah 1:18?

options.text: Jacob a fire, Joseph a flame, and Esau for stubble
Jacob a lion, Joseph an eagle, and Esau for a worm
Jacob a river, Joseph a fountain, and Esau a desert
Jacob a rock, Joseph a fortress, and Esau as dust

questions.text: Whose shall the kingdom be in the end according to Obadiah 1:21?

options.text: It shall be of the house of Joseph
The kingdom shall be the LORD’s
It shall be of the house of Jacob
It shall be of the children of Israel
